# The World represented in the grammar both ways, its amounts not

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`the-world-represented-both-ways` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](the-world-represented-both-ways.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> The World's relations are a model of the grammar both ways: every re-identification is a correspondence of its name-free part, and every relational part is some world's. Its amounts are not: the model does not determine standings, and balance is carried only by conservation's step.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A one-to-one correspondence of carriers («一一对应», with its inverse and composite) carries R to R' where the image of R along it is R' («谓» («像» e.to R) R'), exactly where two things are related exactly where their images are («对应之像»); read back and pointwise, the inverse carries back, composites carry the composite, and every relation on the second carrier is the image of what it reads back. (`Becoming.«一一对应»`, `Becoming.«一一对应».symm`, `Becoming.«一一对应».trans`, `Becoming.«一一对应».to_eq_iff`, `Becoming.«对应之像»`, `Becoming.«对应之逐点»`, `Becoming.«对应之回»`, `Becoming.«回之像»`, `Becoming.«谓之自反»`, `Becoming.«反对应之像»`, `Becoming.«合成之像»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
2. Carrying is kept by the grammar's operations, the meet, the converse, composition and reach («合之像», «逆之像», «而之像», «及之像»), and inclusion is kept («则之对应»); identity and the one are carried («静之像», «一之像»), and a predicate is carried as its partial identity «合» «静» (fun x _ => P x) where it holds exactly where it holds at the image («部分恒等之像»). (`Becoming.«合之像»`, `Becoming.«逆之像»`, `Becoming.«而之像»`, `Becoming.«及之像»`, `Becoming.«则之对应»`, `Becoming.«静之像»`, `Becoming.«一之像»`, `Becoming.«部分恒等之像»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
3. The continuation family is kept: a correspondence carrying 缘 and the class carries reach, continuation, lines, reach on a line, closure and families, having a condition or a consequence, beginning, ending, abiding, alteration (with the finer class), renewal and going on without end, each at x exactly where at e.to x (and the nine more of the family). (`Becoming.«及之对应»`, `Becoming.«续之对应»`, `Becoming.«相续之对应»`, `Becoming.«所及之对应»`, `Becoming.«所闭之对应»`, `Becoming.«同族之对应»`, `Becoming.«有前之对应»`, `Becoming.«有后之对应»`, `Becoming.«生之对应»`, `Becoming.«亡之对应»`, `Becoming.«住之对应»`, `Becoming.«异之对应»`, `Becoming.«复生之对应»`, `Becoming.«不穷之对应»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* closure; its declarations reach the grammar.
4. Being a class, acyclicity and constancy are kept both ways, and the core is kept at every pair: forward through the image of the witnessing relation, back through the relation it reads back («类之对应», «无环之对应», «有常之对应», «核之对应»). (`Becoming.«类之对应»`, `Becoming.«无环之对应»`, `Becoming.«有常之对应»`, `Becoming.«核之对应»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
5. The map's terms are kept: carrying renewal, a carrying renewal within reach, generation and keeping in the strong form, and reaching an end («传之对应», «所及有传之对应», «全生成之对应», «全守之对应», «有终之对应»). (`Becoming.«传之对应»`, `Becoming.«所及有传之对应»`, `Becoming.«全生成之对应»`, `Becoming.«全守之对应»`, `Becoming.«有终之对应»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
6. Ending on every branch is pulled back along any map carrying continuation from a region closed under it into continuation of another model, with no inverse («尽之拉回»); its keeping by a correspondence is two cases of it («尽之对应»). (`Becoming.«尽之拉回»`, `Becoming.«尽之对应»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
7. The occurrence model's name-free part: the class of being at the same step, conservation's step, a relation within each step, and the partial identity of a predicate (Web.sameStep, World.conservationStep, World.withinStep, Web.partialIdentity); the names' step is the step along the names' continuation (Steps.along_iff_itself). (`Becoming.Web.sameStep`, `Becoming.Web.sameStep_class`, `Becoming.Web.partialIdentity`, `Becoming.World.conservationStep`, `Becoming.World.withinStep`, `Becoming.Steps.along_iff_itself`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar's vocabulary only.
8. A later step, and the same step or later, are read at the model along the names and across by the same step (Steps.later_iff, Steps.sameOrLater_iff); so arising and ceasing recurring are statements at the model through the names' step, each with the conjunct that an occurrence exists (World.arisingRecurs_iff, World.ceasingRecurs_iff). (`Becoming.Steps.later_iff`, `Becoming.Steps.sameOrLater_iff`, `Becoming.World.arisingRecurs_iff`, `Becoming.World.ceasingRecurs_iff`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* closure; its declarations reach the grammar.
9. Every re-identification is a one-to-one correspondence of the relata at each step and of the occurrences, carrying the name-free part's ten relations: the same-step class, conservation's step (its conservation is the carried one), activity, standing and presence as partial identities, and five relations within a step; so beginning under conservation is fixed (World.reidentify_carries and nine more). (`Becoming.Reidentify.atStep`, `Becoming.Reidentify.onOccurrences`, `Becoming.Reidentify.sameStep_carried`, `Becoming.Reidentify.withinStep_carried`, `Becoming.Reidentify.partialIdentity_carried`, `Becoming.World.conserves_reidentify`, `Becoming.World.conservationStep_reidentify`, `Becoming.World.activityClass_reidentify`, `Becoming.World.reidentify_carries`, `Becoming.World.sheng_conservation_reidentify`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
10. The relational part ranges over everything: any activity, requiring, drawing and presence is some world's, with no amount, and at the model any predicate's partial identity, two relations lying within a step and presence lists are the relational part of a world's model (World.ofRelations, World.ofModel and their lemmas). (`Becoming.World.ofRelations`, `Becoming.World.ofRelations_relations`, `Becoming.World.ofModel`, `Becoming.World.ofModel_model`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar's vocabulary only.
11. Conservation is exactly a relation 'f's standing after the step with b is a': every world's has this form by definition, and every such relation is some world's, one relatum exchanging (World.conserves_form, World.ofConservationForm_conserves); through one conserving pair it is labelled by standings after the step, so difunctional (World.conserves_iff_same_level, World.conserves_difunctional). (`Becoming.World.conserves_form`, `Becoming.World.ofConservationForm`, `Becoming.World.ofConservationForm_conserves`, `Becoming.World.conserves_iff_same_level`, `Becoming.World.conserves_difunctional`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
12. What amounts induce is decided: conservation, a need met, giving, taking, standing and falling; on one relatum, conservation is a proposition Q across every step exactly where Q is decided, a lemma of whole-number equations (compare indicates_iff_decided); and that every world decides its activity is exactly excluded middle (World.amounts_decided and three more). (`Becoming.World.conserves_decided`, `Becoming.World.amounts_decided`, `Becoming.World.conservation_iff_decided`, `Becoming.World.decides_activity_iff_em`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
13. F1, standings not determined: two worlds standing at positive k and k', with nothing exchanged, agree at every step on each field the model's selection reads (activity, standing, requiring, drawing, presence, a need met, giving, taking, conservation, falling), while their standings are k and k' (World.standingAt_alike). (`Becoming.World.standingAt`, `Becoming.World.standingAt_alike`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
14. F1′, balance not determined by the web and the signs of exchange: no property of a world's web and its signs of exchange (who is present, who gives to and takes from whom) that keeps to the signs' agreement is balance; the idle world balances and its double, giving itself two units, does not (World.balance_needs_conservation and five more). (`Becoming.World.ExchangeSigns`, `Becoming.World.exchangeSigns`, `Becoming.World.ExchangeSigns.Agree`, `Becoming.World.idleTwice`, `Becoming.World.idleTwice_unbalanced`, `Becoming.World.balance_needs_conservation`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* balance; its declarations do not reach the grammar, which represents balance and cannot state it without amounts.
15. F2, identity not induced: where conservation across a step is identity, the standings after it tell every two relata apart, and no map of the predicates on Nat into Nat is one to one (from Diagonal.claims_incomplete), so on the predicates of Nat conservation is never identity (World.not_conserves_identity and two more). (`Becoming.World.conserves_identity_injective`, `Becoming.Diagonal.no_injection_of_predicates`, `Becoming.World.not_conserves_identity`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
16. F3, a line of falls ends: along the names it ends on every branch, from the amounts' law of falls ending at whole numbers (Amounts.falls_end) through «尽之拉回», so it does not go on without end and no world with a relatum falls at every occurrence; a line under a class holding everywhere goes on without end, so this is a condition of the image (World.falls_exhaust and three more). (`Becoming.World.falls_exhaust`, `Becoming.World.falls_not_endless`, `Becoming.World.not_falls_everywhere`, `Becoming.Steps.along_endless`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* closure; its declarations reach the grammar.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- The World's modelling commitments: discrete steps with one shared index, the same relata at every step, whole-number amounts, Prop-valued activity, requiring and drawing, and equality on relata.
- The name-free part is a stated selection: amounts read only by sign, against a need and in conservation's equation, the index only through the same-step class and the steps' own 缘; a re-identification carries more, such as a standing's value or the step order.
- The forward direction is a schema of instance theorems; transport is shown for the terms listed in GrammarTransport, each with the relations it reads carried.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That amounts are represented: the model does not determine a world's standings, so a world is not recovered from its model.
- That balance is derived: at the occurrence model only conservation's step carries it, defined from the balance equation; unit pairings and an idle added relatum are near-definitional too; F1′ reads the web and signs only.
- The amount part's image beyond conservation alone: its form is exact taken alone, with one relatum present; the joint image with presence, falls and the other relations is open.
- Anything beyond whole amounts: decidedness comes from their equations; F2 gives not identity, not two relata standing alike; F3 runs along one relatum's line, on the least loss one, not settling rest as no endless fall.
- That a world leaves its activity undecided: none can be shown to (not_not_decided); what holds is that every world deciding it is exactly excluded middle, activity being Prop-valued, a modelling choice.
- A forward theorem: no statement says every World notion is a grammar term, and that keeping to correspondences gives a term is not stated, the embedding having no syntax of terms.
- Re-identification beyond the ten relations and the class of activity: that the names' step is carried only by renamings the same at every step, and the faithful but not full reading, are not in Lean.
- A representation through the order of joined exchanges; whether the descent laws follow from F3; interpretation with Lean; the grammar's terms not listed in GrammarTransport. Processes are represented in processes-represented-both-ways.
- **Counterexample:** Two worlds of one relatum, never active, standing at 1 and at 2 throughout with nothing exchanged, agree on every field the model reads (World.standingAt_alike): the model does not determine standings. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/WorldRepresentation.lean)
- **Counterexample:** The idle world, one relatum never active and standing at the number of steps, gives itself one unit a step and balances; giving itself two it does not, with the same web and signs of exchange (World.balance_needs_conservation). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/WorldRepresentation.lean)
- **Counterexample:** On the predicates of Nat as relata, conservation across a step is identity in no world (World.not_conserves_identity). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/WorldRepresentation.lean)
- **Counterexample:** The model of one relatum's line of steps under the class of a predicate holding everywhere goes on without end, while no world's line of falls does (Steps.along_endless, World.falls_not_endless). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/WorldRepresentation.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · The model omits relations; what it omits it neither shows nor rules out.

<a id="evidence--证据"></a>
## Evidence

Pure core, every axiom report empty: GrammarTransport imports GrammarLaws, WorldRepresentation imports ContinuedClasses, Decidedness, Diagonal and GrammarTransport; both compile with the whole package and no name clash. Modelling choices: the World's own; the witnesses are single small worlds; every result is pointwise, with no function extensionality.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

That definable properties are kept by isomorphisms of structures is standard model theory; here it is shown term by term, since the grammar is embedded with no syntax of terms. Difunctional relations are Riguet's (1948). The no-injection lemma is the constructive form of Cantor's theorem for a powerset, through the package's diagonal lemma (Lawvere 1969 states the general form). That conservation is labelled by standings is the cancellation of a whole-number equation. The representation is an interpretation of the World into grammar models, faithful on re-identifications and not injective on amounts. Graded in WRT's DESIGN.md.
